name: ea-force-spawn
title: Earth build T18 second-force spawn probe (test only)
author: Jake Mismas
description: Test tool, never shipped. T18 (c), D31: reads the mod under test's folded city offsets at (0, 0), places a second force's spawn at other cities from the mod's shipped data only, generates each spawn's chunk and records its tile and elevation to script-output/ea-force-spawn/spawns.json. The runner writes force-spawn-spec.lua into a staged copy at run time.
